content.description: Blockaid delivers proactive security tools that stop malicious transactions before they occur, shielding web3 users from scams, phishing, and hacks. It is the only web3 security solution with internet-wide, proactive dApp scanning. Each day, Blockaid scans more than 15 million sites and identifies hundreds of new malicious dApps, instantly protecting users across Blockaid-enabled wallets and dApps. When a threat is detected by any user, all Blockaid-enabled users gain immediate protection. Simulations run 100x faster than the status quo, so you can tell in moments whether a transaction or dApp is risky.
